title: 50 new features in GTA 6
creator: T5G
description: T5G’s countdown takes you from a roadside whale sculpture to a scuba dive and a basketball shootaround. We picked five scenes you can jump to below.
momentSource: Editorial scene cues checked against YouTube’s public preview frames

moments.title: Scuba diver exploring underwater
moments.question: Where can I see scuba diving in GTA 6?
moments.answer: Jump to 2:10 in T5G’s countdown for an underwater view of a diver in scuba gear.

moments.title: The character and dog scene
moments.question: Where is the dog scene in T5G’s GTA 6 video?
moments.answer: Skip to 8:00. Look beside the character for the dog in this short scene.

moments.title: Basketball outside the raised house
moments.question: Where does T5G show basketball in GTA 6?
moments.answer: At 8:50 the action moves outside a raised house for a basketball shootaround.

title: A Bigfoot encounter in Leonida
creator: Dan Allen Gaming
description: Dan Allen Gaming shows the encounter he identifies as Bigfoot and includes the location. The two-minute clip reveals the mystery.

title: The Easter egg at the top of the radio tower
creator: TheGamingRevolution
description: See the view from the first platform, then jump to 6:14 for the nest at the summit. TheGamingRevolution shows what’s inside it.

moments.title: Nest and painted egg on the upper platform
moments.question: What is at the top of the GTA 6 radio tower in this video?
moments.answer: TheGamingRevolution reaches a nest with a painted egg on the upper platform. Jump to 6:14 for the reveal, or start at 0:00 for the map and climb.

title: Inside Jason’s safehouse
creator: Robbin Rams
description: Robbin Rams walks through Jason’s home room by room, stopping at objects you can interact with and small details you might otherwise pass.

title: 15 things to do first in GTA 6
creator: GamingBolt
description: GamingBolt starts in the options menus. Watch for movement, aiming and interface settings you can adjust before the first mission.

title: 75 things to do around Leonida
creator: MrSnubbles
description: MrSnubbles organizes pre-release material by what you can do on foot, on the water and at home. Use the chapter links to jump to the activities you’re interested in.

title: A first drive around Vice City
creator: MrRoflWaffles
description: Ride along with MrRoflWaffles on PS5 Pro. Staying at street level gives you time to look at the neighborhoods during the drive.
guideLabel: Try driving with the minimap off

title: T5G’s guide to the new vehicles
creator: T5G
description: T5G sorts the vehicles in this pre-release video into its own rarity groups. Jump to a group to compare the featured cars.

title: 48 things to do in GTA 6
creator: Quiet Billions
description: Quiet Billions covers cars, character systems and the open world. The narrator identifies which examples come from official announcements, reviews or previews.

title: Gyms, basketball and fishing
creator: TGG
description: TGG’s pre-release activity rundown includes separate stops for gym visits, basketball and kayaking. Use the time links to skip to a sport.

title: PS5 and PS5 Pro graphics compared
creator: ElAnalistaDeBits
description: ElAnalistaDeBits compares the same game on two consoles. Look at the reflections and distant objects to see the differences the creator discusses.

title: Digital Foundry examines the details of Vice City
creator: Digital Foundry
description: John Linneman explores apartment interactions, pedestrian behavior and the surfaces in a gas station. The chapter links take you to each comparison in the technical review.

title: Lab Fees and the two keypads
creator: GTA Series Videos
description: Follow Jason from the shop to Brian’s lockup. Jump directly to the green shop keypad or the blue lockup wall if you only need to recognize the door.
guideLabel: Find both Lab Fees door codes

moments.title: Keypad on the green shop wall
moments.question: Which Lab Fees door takes 0420?
moments.answer: Use 0420 at the shop’s back-room keypad. At 2:30 the green wall identifies the first door in the footage.

moments.title: Keypad on the blue lockup wall
moments.question: Where do I enter 7700 in Lab Fees?
moments.answer: Enter 7700 at Brian’s lockup. At 4:30 you can see the second keypad on the blue wall.

title: Unwanted Attention and the red Phoenix
creator: GTA Series Videos
description: Follow the impound objective with GTA Series Videos. At 5:30, Jason is beside the rear of the red Phoenix among the other vehicles.
guideLabel: Find the Phoenix in the impound

title: The free repair in Just a Scratch
creator: GTA Series Videos
description: The pickup enters Coastal Auto Care. At 1:20, the hood is up and the screen offers a free repair. Continue watching to see the customization menus.

moments.title: Free repair prompt with the hood open
Paint colors in the Respray menu

title: GTA 6 Prologue walkthrough
creator: GTA Series Videos
description: GTA Series Videos plays through the opening without commentary. Its chapter markers let you move between the opening timeline and the present-day scenes.

title: Gone Fishing walkthrough
creator: GTA Series Videos
description: Watch GTA Series Videos play the early boat mission from start to finish. The companion guide explains what to do if Cal won’t collect a package.
guideLabel: Get Cal to collect the package

title: Gear Up walkthrough
creator: GTA Series Videos
description: Watch the early shop visit in Gear Up without commentary. The written walkthrough covers the shop menu and the item that advances the objective.
guideLabel: Find Andrew’s counter in Gear Up
